meaningEvidence: Exact owner-account published media record binds this MP4 to the TikTok ID; full36.949333s source and timeline reviewed.
Crowd, police, Palestinian and Albanian flags, a blue banner and news lower-thirds are visible. Added Albanian text describes flag removal and calls for focus on Albanian anticorruption.
Underlying Albanian audio is a news reporter discussing police movement; this is not Eduard’s eyewitness narration. Meaning is established from the visible added text and exact post caption.
limitations: Original recording date, individual identities and flag-removal authority/circumstances not independently established.
No claim that every participant represents an ideology, that state capture is legally established, or that the video proves a corrupt transaction.
No endorsement or legal determination of the physical intervention is inferred.
